title: Per-modulus classification of weak generalized Schur colorings of cyclic groups (x+y=kz mod n, two colors, pairwise-distinct variables)
domain: Combinatorial number theory / Ramsey theory on groups
problem: For which (n, k) does Z_n admit a 2-coloring with no monochromatic pairwise-distinct solution to x + y = k*z (mod n)? Determine Good(n,k) completely.
hypothesis: CLASSIFICATION: For all n >= 12, Good(n,k) iff k=0, or (n even and k=n/2), or (9|n and k in {n/3, 2n/3}). For n<=11 a finite exceptional table applies (small_n_tables.json). k=2 case is classical (Grier 2012).
baseline: No prior classification exists (novelty audit 2). Nearest objects: cyclic van der Waerden numbers (k=2 only); Chappelon et al./D'orville et al. modular weak Schur numbers on intervals with fixed modulus; Sanders 2026 asymptotic bounds.
proposed_improvement: First complete per-modulus classification for the family, with fully proved construction direction and certified exhaustive verification of the converse.

experimental_evidence.what: Exhaustive exact determination of Good(n,k) for ALL n in [12,60] and ALL residues k: matches classification with zero mismatches (~1700 instances)
experimental_evidence.how_to_reproduce: python research/sessions/S6/code/sat_solver.py ; sweep script in sessions/S6/code (see report for commands)

experimental_evidence.what: Construction families verified: k=0 valid n=[3,600]; k=n/2 valid even n=[12,600]; k=n/3 & 2n/3 valid t=[1,150] both signs
Triple solver agreement (DFS backtracking, CDCL SAT via python-sat, naive brute force) on all contested points incl. (11,10),(11,6),(30,10),(54,36)
Small-n tables n=3..11 all residues certified

adversarial_attacks.attack: Independent novelty-audit agent instructed to kill the claim (81 tool calls)
adversarial_attacks.outcome: k>=3 classification NOT FOUND in literature; k=2 sub-case killed -> credited to Grier, Geombinatorics 21(4) 2012

adversarial_attacks.attack: Attempted hand proof of false generalization (EH sumset bound claiming primes p>=11 all-bad) refuted by certified instances (11,6),(11,10) colorable; analysis corrected
adversarial_attacks.outcome: badness proofs must treat degeneracy slack E={x in A : (k-1)x in A}; roadmap in THEORY doc

novelty_notes: See research/literature/S6M-novelty.md. Adjacent objects (Chappelon et al. 2013; D'orville et al. 2025; Sanders 2026) are interval-based fixed-modulus quantities or bounds-only; none classifies Z_n per modulus for k>=3.
next_action: (1) Prove badness direction strata-by-strata (roadmap THEORY sec.7: EH bound + degeneracy graph + quotient/gcd strata). (2) Extend exhaustive verification beyond n=60. (3) Formalize constructions in Lean 4 when toolchain available. (4) Independent reproduction of solver tables.
